import sys, json
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def num(x, nd=2):
    return round(float(x), nd)


def main():
    df = pd.read_csv(sys.argv[1])
    facts = []

    def add(entity, metric, period, value, formula, nd=2):
        if value is None or (isinstance(value, float) and not np.isfinite(value)):
            return
        if pd.isna(value):
            return
        facts.append({
            "entity": str(entity),
            "metric": metric,
            "period": period,
            "value": num(value, nd),
            "formula": formula,
        })

    rev_tw = df["Revenue_TW"].sum(skipna=True)
    rev_lw = df["Revenue_LW"].sum(skipna=True)
    rev_ly = df["Revenue_LY"].sum(skipna=True)
    u_tw = df["Units_TW"].sum(skipna=True)
    u_lw = df["Units_LW"].sum(skipna=True)
    o_tw = df["Orders_TW"].sum(skipna=True)
    o_lw = df["Orders_LW"].sum(skipna=True)

    # Totals
    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "TW", rev_tw, "sum(Revenue_TW)")
    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "LW", rev_lw, "sum(Revenue_LW)")
    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "LY", rev_ly, "sum(Revenue_LY)")
    if rev_lw and rev_lw != 0:
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "WoW", (rev_tw - rev_lw) / rev_lw * 100,
            "(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LW)) / sum(Revenue_LW) * 100", 1)
    if rev_ly and rev_ly != 0:
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "YoY", (rev_tw - rev_ly) / rev_ly * 100,
            "(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LY)) / sum(Revenue_LY) * 100", 1)
    add("TOTAL", "units", "TW", u_tw, "sum(Units_TW)")
    if u_lw:
        add("TOTAL", "units", "WoW", (u_tw - u_lw) / u_lw * 100,
            "(sum(Units_TW) - sum(Units_LW)) / sum(Units_LW) * 100", 1)
    add("TOTAL", "orders", "TW", o_tw, "sum(Orders_TW)")
    if o_lw:
        add("TOTAL", "orders", "WoW", (o_tw - o_lw) / o_lw * 100,
            "(sum(Orders_TW) - sum(Orders_LW)) / sum(Orders_LW) * 100", 1)

    # Top entities by revenue this week
    top = df.dropna(subset=["Revenue_TW"]).sort_values("Revenue_TW", ascending=False).head(5)
    for _, r in top.iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "TW", r["Revenue_TW"], "Revenue_TW for this product")
    for _, r in top.head(3).iterrows():
        sh = r["Share_Pct"] if pd.notna(r["Share_Pct"]) else (
            r["Revenue_TW"] / rev_tw * 100 if rev_tw else np.nan)
        add(r["Entity"], "share", "TW", sh, "Revenue_TW / sum(Revenue_TW) * 100", 1)
    if len(top):
        add(top.iloc[0]["Entity"], "rank", "TW", top.iloc[0]["Rank"],
            "rank by Revenue_TW (1 = highest)", 0)

    # Top 5 combined share
    if rev_tw:
        add("TOTAL", "share", "TW", top["Revenue_TW"].sum() / rev_tw * 100,
            "sum(top 5 Revenue_TW) / sum(Revenue_TW) * 100", 1)

    # Biggest absolute WoW movers
    d = df.dropna(subset=["Revenue_TW", "Revenue_LW"]).copy()
    d["abs_wow"] = d["Revenue_TW"] - d["Revenue_LW"]
    for _, r in d.sort_values("abs_wow", ascending=False).head(3).iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", r["abs_wow"], "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW")
    for _, r in d.sort_values("abs_wow").head(3).iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", r["abs_wow"], "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW")

    # Biggest percent WoW movers among material products
    thr = rev_tw * 0.005 if rev_tw else 0
    dm = d[(d["Revenue_LW"] > 0) & ((d["Revenue_TW"] >= thr) | (d["Revenue_LW"] >= thr))]
    dm = dm.dropna(subset=["WoW_Pct"])
    for _, r in dm.sort_values("WoW_Pct", ascending=False).head(2).iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", r["WoW_Pct"],
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100", 1)
    for _, r in dm.sort_values("WoW_Pct").head(2).iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", r["WoW_Pct"],
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100", 1)

    # Biggest YoY movers
    y = df.dropna(subset=["Revenue_TW", "Revenue_LY"]).copy()
    y = y[y["Revenue_LY"] > 0]
    y["abs_yoy"] = y["Revenue_TW"] - y["Revenue_LY"]
    for _, r in y.sort_values("abs_yoy", ascending=False).head(2).iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", r["abs_yoy"], "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY")
    for _, r in y.sort_values("abs_yoy").head(2).iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", r["abs_yoy"], "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY")
    ym = y.dropna(subset=["YoY_Pct"])
    ym = ym[ym["Revenue_TW"] >= thr]
    for _, r in ym.sort_values("YoY_Pct", ascending=False).head(1).iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", r["YoY_Pct"],
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY) / Revenue_LY * 100", 1)

    # Top by units and orders
    ut = df.dropna(subset=["Units_TW"]).sort_values("Units_TW", ascending=False).head(2)
    for _, r in ut.iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "units", "TW", r["Units_TW"], "Units_TW for this product", 0)
    ot = df.dropna(subset=["Orders_TW"]).sort_values("Orders_TW", ascending=False).head(1)
    for _, r in ot.iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "orders", "TW", r["Orders_TW"], "Orders_TW for this product", 0)

    print(json.dumps(facts[:25]))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
